clientSecret.description: OAuth2 client secret. Only included when the caller explicitly requests expand=oauth.clientSecret and only for DIRECT plugins. Never exposed for BACKEND_PROXY or STATE_MANAGED. Used by the website to complete direct PKCE token exchanges client-side.

requiresCodeVerifier.description: Whether PKCE code verifier is required

additionalAuthorizeParams.description: Additional query parameters that the website appends to the OAuth2 authorization URL when redirecting the user to the provider's consent screen (e.g., access_type=offline, prompt=consent).

oauthVariant.description: OAuth flow variant. DIRECT performs the PKCE token exchange client-side. BACKEND_PROXY sends the authorization code to the backend exchange. STATE_MANAGED uses POST /plugin-oauth-authorizations followed by POST /plugin-oauth-authorization-completions. The server owns state, provider configuration and credential installation; the client never exchanges tokens or supplies client credentials. This variant is advertised only when the configured state-managed host flow is ready.
